series_diffs: Candidate has a cleaner studio-portrait presentation, while most reference characters and scenes feel more handmade and visibly embedded in a toy-diorama world.
Eyes are slightly larger, glossier, and more animation-character-like than the small, simpler dot eyes used across the group and scene references.
Skin is smoother and more evenly rendered than the references’ subtly irregular matte-clay surfaces.
Hair has deeper grooves and polished sculptural definition, giving it a mildly generic high-quality 3D-character finish compared with the simpler clay hair in the references.
The shirt and apron show slightly more fabric-like texture than the consistently molded-clay clothing of the reference figures.
issues: Series match is close to the gate: reducing eye size and gloss, making skin and clothing more matte and hand-molded, and simplifying the hair would better anchor the character in the established JIBUN CHOICE world.
The meal tray communicates food service clearly, but the exact shop role is somewhat ambiguous without a stronger non-text occupational cue such as a counter or serving utensil.
